logic_summary: count = 0; for idx in 0..menu_party_member_count-1: if fd2_check_char_is_dead(idx) == 1 (runtime_char[idx].flags & CHARFLAG_DEAD, i.e. bit 0 set) then out_list_buf[count] = (uint8)idx, count++.
